seeds.rule: disjoint from the P6 blocks 65001-65100, 65501-65900 and the v21.b2 development blocks 69801-69900, 69901-70300

design: balanceTool.v21 (template table v21.b2). For each side: the template plus that one choice on that side, std on the other, paired by seed against the template without the choice on that side. Same instrument as P6 stage 2 (runTruthMatch, items standard, skills on)

plan.rule: every row of the four result files (P6 stage 1 and 2 for classic.m3 / m7 / m8, whose values are identical in v21.b1 and v21.b2; the v21.b2 study stage 1 and 2 for classic.m6 / v2.hard_engage_stack / v2.three_lane_pressure) with stage-1 pass or stage-2 confirmed; the tool refuses if this list differs from what those files derive
plan.controls: one per side and template (classic.m3, classic.m6, classic.m7, classic.m8)
plan.expectedEffort: about 5.1 h single line at the 1.28 s/match measured on 2026-11-03

decisionRule.confirmed: on BOTH sides n >= 200 valid pairs, z >= 3 and relative effect >= 0.05 in the claimed direction
decisionRule.source: the replication rule of tactic_followup_3a_replication.json, the same as P6 stage 2
decisionRule.notReplicated: a side with n >= 200 valid pairs misses the rule

overall.PASS: every item confirmed, no errored match
overall.FAILED: any item not_replicated: a failed check of the formal acceptance (stopRules.anyOtherRed), reported to the Owner; rows are not edited to make it pass
overall.INCONCLUSIVE: any item with fewer than 200 valid pairs on a side and none not_replicated, or any errored match up to 1% of the planned matches, which gives no verdict on any item: the Owner decides

decisionRule.minValidPairsAuthority: Owner Review 2026-11-02 decision 3; lowering it after the fact is forbidden
decisionRule.achievability: checked before registering, from raw records, no reserved seed: the 13 P6 metrics are valid in 100 of 100 matches on the blue side and in 100 of 100 on the red side of the same matches (a proxy: stage 1 ran blue arms only); the two stage-2 items measured 400 of 400 on both sides. classic.m6 invasionsActed: valid in 200 of 200 records on each side of the v21.b2 study (the same proxy: red played std there). Expected about 400 per side, far above the floor
decisionRule.order: not_replicated when a side with n >= 200 misses the rule; otherwise inconclusive when a side has n < 200; otherwise confirmed
decisionRule.inconclusive: no side misses the rule and a side has n < 200 valid pairs
decisionRule.mixedCase: a side with n >= 200 that misses the rule makes the item not_replicated and the study FAILED, even when the other side has n < 200; that other side is recorded in insufficientSides (Owner approval 2026-11-02)

noRetries: no re-run, no seed swap, no metric swap, no seed dropped by hand
notClaimed: behaviour only. No win-rate claim for a table template combined with a choice: that is a known verification gap and not a pass (stage1r2_formal_acceptance_registration_3aB.json knownVerificationGaps)

requiresResult.why: stopRules.ga8: the confirmatory G-A8 runs FIRST and a STOP halts every other formal measurement; INCONCLUSIVE goes to the Owner. Enforced by the tool, not by procedure
